lines: Hi. This is the girl from the night train. Window seat.
You fell asleep on my shoulder somewhere after the second tunnel, and I didn't have the heart to move.
You left this tape on the seat. The first side is all your songs. I've listened to it eleven times.
So I'm recording on Side B. If this is strange, just rewind, and pretend I never said anything.
It's not strange.
Okay. It's a little strange. A tape came in the post with no letter, just your voice. I played it standing in the hallway with my coat still on.
I'm sorry about your shoulder.
I'm not sorry, actually.
Tell me what your mornings sound like. Mine sound like this.
[AMBIENCE:morning]
That's the kettle. It whistles like it's angry at me.
Mine sound like the sea. Can you hear it? I held the recorder out of the window for you.
[AMBIENCE:sea]
It's four hundred kilometres between us. Eleven hours, by the slow train. I looked it up. Twice.
I play your tapes before I sleep now. I know the bit where you laugh at your own joke before you finish it.
It's ridiculous. We've spent forty minutes in the same place.
And I know the sound of your sea better than my own street.
I have to tell you something.
They've offered me work on a ship. Six months. Maybe longer. Further than eleven hours.
I said I'd think about it.
I've been thinking about you instead.
Go. You should go.
I'm saying that because it's the right thing to say. Please don't listen to the right thing.
I don't know what we are. People don't fall for a voice.
Maybe they do.
The ship leaves on the fourteenth. I'm taking the first train out. The six ten.
I'm not asking you to come.
I'm just telling you which window I'll be sitting at.
Side B is almost full, so I'll be quick.
It's the fourteenth. It's five in the morning. I'm on a platform, holding your umbrella.
I'm not getting on a train to say goodbye. I'm getting on the one that goes to your sea.
If you've already gone, I'll wait by the water.
And if you stayed, if you got on a train to find me,
[AMBIENCE:horn]
then I suppose we'll pass each other, somewhere after the second tunnel.
Side A. Track one. This one's for the girl on the platform.
